subject.title: fix(gateway): keep node pending work until work.ack

question: Should durable node work use a new capability-gated read/ack protocol while preserving legacy `node.pending.drain`, or may the shipped drain method become at-least-once for all clients?
rationale: The repository shipped the consume-on-drain contract while deliberately leaving the intended mobile consumer outside the original foundation PR; choosing the permanent cross-version Gateway protocol requires owner intent.

options.title: Add a negotiated read/ack path
options.body: Keep legacy drain semantics and introduce a new method or advertised capability that supported clients adopt atomically.

options.title: Approve a coordinated breaking change
options.body: Change the existing method only after every supported consumer is identified, updated, and upgrade-tested together.

options.title: Defer pending-work recovery
options.body: Pause this PR until the consuming node workflow has a clear owner and can land with the Gateway change.

recommendation.title: Add a negotiated read/ack path
recommendation.body: Keep legacy drain semantics and introduce a new method or advertised capability that supported clients adopt atomically.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shipped queue contract and documented the original consumer boundary, making them the strongest available protocol-direction owner.
